podcast.title: Joe Young - The Blues Singer
podcast.body: An old Chicago blues singer named Joe Young played a significant role in Stone Temple Pilots' early history, as his objection to the band Mighty Joe Young using his name forced them to find a new identity. "An old Chicago blues singer named Joe Young, objected to the band using the name Mighty Joe Young because that's the name he used to use."
